Core Capabilities

Production-ready features for autonomous, intelligent task execution

Intelligent Planning

Decomposes complex tasks into ordered, structured steps before executing anything

Autonomous Execution

Selects and runs the right tools — financial APIs, web search, document parsing, company intel

Self-Validation

Checks its own outputs and re-runs if incomplete. Loop detection prevents runaway execution

Real-Time Streaming

Every agent event streams live via S2 — users watch Wilson think in real time

Durable Scratchpad

Every tool call, reasoning step, and result logged as JSONL — fully replayable by session ID

WhatsApp Gateway

Message yourself on WhatsApp — Wilson reads it, runs the task, replies back

Eval Suite

LangSmith-backed evaluation with LLM-as-judge scoring across benchmark task dataset

All capabilities work together to create a truly autonomous agent system

Getting Started

Get Wilson up and running in minutes

Prerequisites

✓
Bun v1.0+ - Required runtime
✓
OpenAI API key - For LLM capabilities
✓
Financial Datasets API - For financial data
○
Optional APIs - Anthropic, Exa, LangSmith

1. Clone the Repository

git clone https://github.com/GeekyRiolu/Wilson.git && cd wilson

2. Install Dependencies

bun install

3. Configure Environment

Add your API keys: OPENAI_API_KEY, FINANCIAL_DATASETS_API_KEY

cp env.example .env

4. Run Wilson

bun start
